description: Shows a manuscript text file (.txt) as pages typeset the same way as its PDF. Define the layout, such as characters × lines, the way you set up a page in Word. English manuscripts are detected automatically and typeset like a paperback.
command.open: Open Novel Preview to the Side
command.exportPdf: Export a PDF in the Current Layout
command.backup: Back Up to the Remote Repository
configuration.title: Novel Preview
config.defaultPreset: Name of the preset to use when no novel.json is found above the manuscript.
config.presets: Additional layout presets (name → definition). You can also add one with "Page Setup > Save as Preset" in the preview. Those with `"english": true` are for English manuscripts.
config.presets.english: English layout (paper, margins, fontSize, lineHeight). Shown only for English manuscripts
config.presets.writingMode: Writing direction (vertical / horizontal; always horizontal for English)
config.presets.paper: Paper size (6x9in / 5x8in are English paperback trim sizes)
config.presets.lines: Lines per page (null for automatic leading)
config.presets.fontSize: Body font size of the English layout (pt)
config.presets.fontFamily: Body font (empty for the same as the PDF: Mincho for Japanese, EB Garamond for English)
config.prose: Count the distribution of sentence endings in the narration and more with morphological analysis, under "Prose" in the novel panel. The dictionary is loaded the first time that tab is shown and uses about 250 MB of memory, so turn this off if it is heavy (the memory comes back when you reload the window). Character counts are shown even when this is off
config.outDir: Where "Build the Outputs of novel.json" writes, relative to the workspace folder (an absolute path also works). Same as `--out-dir` of `novel build`
config.openAfterExport: Open exported PDFs and RTFs (also for "Export a PDF in the Current Layout"; like `novel build`, EPUBs and split / merge txt files are not opened). They are not opened when the environment variable `AUTO_OPEN=0` is set
config.show.backup: Show the "Back Up to the Remote Repository" button (on the preview toolbar and in the title bar of "Novel Outline") and command. Turn it off if you do not back up with Git
config.show.statusBar: Show the character count, sheets of manuscript paper and layout of the manuscript in the status bar
config.show.editorButtons: Show the buttons in the title bar of the editor of a `.txt` / `novel.json` (open the preview on the side, switch to the preview, open the work settings)
